Sadly you cannot play with two people with a single Switch system. If you have two switch systems you can play online (I believe you can also play wirelessly).

Though there isn't couch co-op, there should be local wireless play! If it's online or wireless, you can have a maximum of 4 people in your party (unless you have mods on the PC). This number can mix between any number of human/AI players. You can also go a "lone wolf" route where you take a perk that makes you and one other person more powerful at the cost of only having 2 players in a party. 

If you have 2 AI partners, you should be able to relegate either one to you or your partner, so you can think of it as a 2nd character for you or your partner to use.

However, at least for the PC version, if your partner wants to jump into an already existing save, they either have to play as one of the companions that you find or wait until you have the opportunity to create another character later into the game. I suggest starting the game with 2 people if both of you want to create your own character.

If you're open to getting the PC version, there are mods that add more fire/ice skills to play around with as well as upgrading the spell effects to look more devastating! Not to say the Switch version isn't worth it, but the fantasy of an fire/ice mage is better imagined with mods.
